reviewFindings: R18M failed before worker start because its path gate omitted an actual final ZIP member.
The omitted payload leaf measured 173 characters at the endpoint pending root and 205 with the required 32-character reserve.

The R18M entrypoint also retained R18J1 work/output defaults even though its signed definition declared R18M1 roots; no-argument endpoint invocation would therefore have violated the declared root contract after the path check.
The reader, crop sweep, corpus worker, and reference files were not reached or modified.
rootCause: Publication relied on a hand-maintained longest-leaf assertion instead of enumerating the exact final signed ZIP, and the entrypoint defaults were not mechanically compared with the signed mutation/output declarations.
authorizedCorrection: In fresh R18N, use request ID REQ_R18N1, set the no-argument entrypoint WorkRoot and OutputRoot defaults to D:\A2\w\ocv\R18N1 and D:\A2\o\ocv\R18N1, retain the observed proposal-root default, enumerate every final ZIP member at every route hop, and require all effective lengths below 200 before publication.
